s1.description: Opening: retrieval warm-up, outcomes and the 3-hour plan

s2.description: Block 1: what plane stress is, where civil engineers use it, and how it differs from plane strain

s3.description: Block 2: derivation of the plane-stress equilibrium equations and their matrix form with the differential operator matrix

s4.description: Block 3: plane-stress constitutive law, strain–displacement relation, and the displacement form of the PDE

s5.description: Block 4: traction and displacement boundary conditions, the rectangular-domain simplification, and the cantilever’s edges

s6.description: Block 5: nodal degrees of freedom of the plane-stress element and the 2-by-8 shape-function matrix

s7.description: Block 6: side-by-side comparison of the heat-transfer and plane-stress pipelines, preview of [B] and [k], exit ticket and preparation
